artboards.title: A — the four tabs as named
C — by stage, not by topic

annotations.text:
Technician View for the job page.

Measured first: the page is 4,222px on a 390x844 phone — five screens, on a job with no photos and nothing filled in.

Three directions, left to right. B is the one I would build.
B: cut what a tech never opens, THEN split the rest. The clock never goes behind a tab, and the tab bar carries what is still missing.
A: exactly the four names from the brief, built honestly — including where it strains. The notes on each tab say where.
C: the same switcher ordered by the job's flow instead of by document type. It moves itself as you clock in and check out.
